reason: The registered gtm handler implements an authenticated generic Google Tag Manager v2 REST proxy, including workspace changes, version creation and publication; all shared marketing tools are included.
server: src/index.ts → startServer() (stdio JSON-RPC; dist/index.js packaged entrypoint)
exposure: All 49 tools registered unconditionally and always listed; individual calls require their respective Google OAuth, Meta token, Places API key or DataForSEO credentials. Google autocomplete needs no credentials.
limitations: Catalog obtained offline from an isolated unmodified source copy using Node 24 TypeScript stripping, empty environment and isolated HOME; network fetch was blocked and only tools/list was invoked. Remote API functionality was not executed.

Schemas are preserved verbatim: descriptive defaults and limits are not JSON Schema constraints; gbp_update_attributes intentionally has an unrestricted array without items, and gbp_update_location has an unrestricted object. Server does not perform JSON Schema validation before dispatch.

GTM is a generic path proxy rather than enumerated resource-specific tools; body is a raw JSON string and its shape is intentionally unconstrained. Availability of arbitrary paths depends on Google API support and granted OAuth scopes.

tools.name: config_status
tools.description: Report which marketing data sources are configured (no secrets revealed). Call first if a tool says 'not configured'.
tools.behavior: Reports configuration presence and configured resource IDs for the shared marketing server without revealing credentials.

tools.name: gsc_query
tools.description: Search Console Search Analytics — clicks / impressions / CTR / position grouped by dimension(s). The core SEO tool (same data as the GSC Performance export, but live + filterable).

dimensions.description: Group by these; omit for site totals.

siteUrl.description: Defaults to GSC_SITE_URL. URL-prefix (trailing slash) or sc-domain: form.

searchType.description: Result type to report. Default web.

filterOperator.description: How filterExpression is matched against filterDimension. Default equals.

filterExpression.description: The value filterDimension is matched against. The filter applies when filterDimension and filterExpression are both set.

tools.behavior: Google Search Console: posts date, dimensions, row limit and optional single dimension filter to searchAnalytics/query.

tools.name: gsc_list_sitemaps

siteUrl.description: Search Console property: URL-prefix form with its trailing slash, or sc-domain:<domain>. Defaults to GSC_SITE_URL.

tools.name: gsc_inspect_url
tools.description: URL Inspection — index/coverage status, last crawl, canonical, mobile usability for one URL.

siteUrl.description: Search Console property: URL-prefix form with its trailing slash, or sc-domain:<domain>. Defaults to GSC_SITE_URL.

tools.name: ga4_run_report
tools.description: GA4 Data API runReport — sessions, users, conversions, events, channels. Flexible dimensions + metrics over a date range.

propertyId.description: Numeric GA4 property id; defaults to GA4_PROPERTY_ID (NOT the G-XXXX measurement id).

limit.description: Maximum rows returned. Defaults to the API's 10,000.

dimensionFilter.description: Dimension name to filter on (exact match).

dimensionFilterValue.description: The exact value dimensionFilter must equal. The filter applies when dimensionFilter and dimensionFilterValue are both set.

tools.name: ga4_realtime
tools.description: GA4 realtime report (active users in the last 30 min).

propertyId.description: Numeric GA4 property id (the property id, distinct from the G- measurement id). Defaults to GA4_PROPERTY_ID.

dimensions.description: Realtime dimension names to group by; omit for totals.

tools.behavior: Google Analytics 4: posts metrics and dimensions to runRealtimeReport.

tools.name: gbp_list_accounts
tools.description: [GBP] List Business Profile accounts. NOTE: the Business Profile APIs require Google to approve API access (allowlist) first.
tools.behavior: Google Business Profile: lists accounts through Account Management API.

tools.name: gbp_list_locations
tools.description: [GBP] List locations for an account (name, title, address, website, categories).
tools.behavior: Google Business Profile: lists account locations using a fixed read mask.

tools.name: gbp_get_location
tools.description: [GBP] Read ONE location in full — description, hours, service area, service items and everything gbp_list_locations omits. Call this before any gbp_update_location so you know the current value of what you are about to overwrite.

readMask.description: Comma-separated field paths. Defaults to every readable field.

tools.behavior: Google Business Profile: gets one location with a supplied or comprehensive default read mask.

tools.name: gbp_search_categories
tools.description: [GBP] Resolve a category display name to the resource name gbp_update_location needs — e.g. 'Cleaners' becomes 'categories/gcid:cleaners'. Categories are referenced by id, never by display text.
tools.behavior: Google Business Profile: searches category display names with region and language filters.

tools.name: gbp_search_places
tools.description: [GBP] Find Google Place IDs by place name, through the Places API (New) with GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY. Returns each match's id, display name and formatted address, up to maxResults. These ids are the placeId values that gbp_update_location's serviceArea entries carry.

query.description: Place to find, e.g. 'Kidlington, Oxfordshire, UK'.

tools.behavior: Google Places: posts text search with API key and returns place IDs, names and addresses for Business Profile service areas.

tools.name: gbp_update_location
tools.description: [GBP][WRITE] Update a location's public business information — categories, phoneNumbers, websiteUri, profile (description), regularHours, serviceArea, serviceItems, title, storefrontAddress. updateMask REPLACES each masked field wholesale, so send the complete value: masking 'categories' while sending only additionalCategories WIPES the primary category. Read the current value with gbp_get_location first and merge. serviceArea places each need a placeId from gbp_search_places: the API accepts an entry that lacks a valid placeId, reports success, and leaves that locality off the profile, so read serviceArea back with gbp_get_location after the write. This edits a public, client-visible profile — run with validateOnly=true first and confirm with the owner before the real write.

updateMask.description: Comma-separated field paths to replace, e.g. 'categories' or 'phoneNumbers,websiteUri'. Mask the PARENT field — 'categories', not 'categories.additionalCategories'.

update.description: Partial Location body carrying the new values, e.g. {"categories":{"primaryCategory":{"name":"categories/gcid:house_cleaning_service"},"additionalCategories":[{"name":"categories/gcid:cleaners"}]}}

validateOnly.description: Dry run — Google validates and returns the would-be result WITHOUT saving. Default false.

tools.behavior: Google Business Profile: patches an arbitrary partial Location object with updateMask and optional validateOnly.

tools.name: gbp_list_available_attributes
tools.description: [GBP] The attributes Google will accept for a location's category — id, valueType (BOOL/ENUM/URL/REPEATED_ENUM), display name and any enum options. Attributes not in this list are rejected; the list depends on the location's primary category, so re-check after any category change.
tools.behavior: Google Business Profile: lists accepted attribute metadata for a location.

tools.name: gbp_get_attributes
tools.description: [GBP] The attributes currently SET on a location. An empty result means none are set — not an error. Read this before gbp_update_attributes so you know what a masked write will replace.
tools.behavior: Google Business Profile: gets attributes set on a location.

tools.name: gbp_update_attributes
tools.description: [GBP][WRITE] Set or clear attributes on a location. attributeMask lists the attribute ids being changed (e.g. 'attributes/url_appointment,attributes/offers_online_estimates'); a masked id with no matching entry in the body is CLEARED. Value shape depends on valueType — BOOL/ENUM: {name, values:[...]}; URL: {name, uriValues:[{uri}]}. Only ids from gbp_list_available_attributes save; anything else 400s. This edits a public, client-visible profile — confirm with the owner before writing, and read back with gbp_get_attributes after.

attributeMask.description: Comma-separated attribute ids being set or cleared.

tools.behavior: Google Business Profile: patches the supplied unrestricted attributes array with attributeMask.

tools.name: gbp_list_posts
tools.description: [GBP] Google Posts on a location (v4 localPosts — the same mybusiness.googleapis.com service as reviews). An empty result means no posts, not an error.
tools.behavior: Google Business Profile: lists localPosts using legacy v4 API.

tools.name: gbp_create_post
tools.description: [GBP][WRITE] Publish a Google Post (v4 localPost, topicType STANDARD). summary is the visible body (≤1500 chars, ~250 shown before truncation); ctaUrl+ctaType add the button; photoUrl must be a PUBLIC https image ≥250×250 or the whole post is rejected. Posts expire from the profile surface after ~7 days — that is Google's design, not data loss. Public and client-visible: confirm the exact text with the owner before writing.

ctaType.description: Button type. Omit for no button.

ctaUrl.description: Button target URL (not used for CALL).

photoUrl.description: Public https image URL, ≥250×250. Omit for text-only.

tools.behavior: Google Business Profile: publishes a STANDARD localPost with summary and optional call to action and photo.

tools.name: gbp_delete_post
tools.description: [GBP][WRITE] Delete a Google Post — the undo for gbp_create_post.

post.description: Full post name from gbp_list_posts, e.g. accounts/123/locations/456/localPosts/789.

tools.behavior: Google Business Profile: deletes a localPost by full resource name.

tools.name: gbp_performance
tools.description: [GBP] Daily performance time series for a location: impressions (maps/search × desktop/mobile), call clicks, website clicks, direction requests, conversations, bookings.
tools.behavior: Google Business Profile: reads daily metric time series with decomposed start and end dates.

tools.name: gbp_list_reviews
tools.description: [GBP] List reviews for a location (rating, comment, reviewer, time, any reply).

location.description: Full path, e.g. accounts/123/locations/456 (v4 reviews API).

tools.behavior: Google Business Profile: lists reviews using legacy v4 API.

tools.name: gbp_reply_review
tools.description: [GBP][WRITE] Post the business's reply to a review, replacing any reply already there (one reply per review). The reply appears publicly on the profile under the review: confirm the exact text with the owner before writing, and read it back with gbp_list_reviews after.

reviewId.description: The reviewId field of a review from gbp_list_reviews: the bare id that follows reviews/ in the review's name.

comment.description: The reply text, exactly as it will appear publicly.

tools.behavior: Google Business Profile: replaces the public reply on a review using PUT.

tools.name: meta_graph
tools.description: Meta Graph / Marketing API call — flexible escape hatch, READ and WRITE. method defaults GET; POST to create/update (e.g. path='<campaignId>', params={status:'PAUSED'}), DELETE to remove. Does anything the token's scopes allow.

method.description: HTTP method. Default GET; POST creates or updates, DELETE removes.

params.description: Fields/params for reads; values for writes.

tools.behavior: Meta Graph / Marketing API: forwards supplied GET, POST or DELETE path and string parameters.

tools.name: meta_page_insights
tools.description: [Meta] Facebook Page insights (impressions, engagement, fans, etc.).
tools.behavior: Meta Facebook: reads configured or supplied Page insights metrics over an optional date range.

tools.name: meta_ad_insights
tools.description: [Meta] Ad account insights (impressions, clicks, spend, actions, CPC, CTR). Only returns data if you actually run Meta ads.
tools.behavior: Meta Marketing API: reads ad account insights with fields, date preset and aggregation level.

tools.name: meta_list_ad_accounts
tools.description: [Meta] List ad accounts the token can access (id, name, status, spend, currency, business). NOTE: amount_spent is in the currency's MINOR unit (cents/pence) — divide by 100 for the real figure. (A SYSTEM-USER token returns [] here — use meta_graph on '<businessId>/owned_ad_accounts' instead.) Start of an ads audit.
tools.behavior: Meta Marketing API: lists accessible ad accounts with status, spend and business fields.

tools.name: meta_list_businesses
tools.description: [Meta] List Business Manager businesses the token can access.
tools.behavior: Meta Business Manager: lists accessible businesses.

tools.name: meta_list_pages
tools.description: [Meta] List Facebook Pages the token manages (id, name, category, fans).
tools.behavior: Meta Facebook: lists managed Pages with category, fan count and tasks.

tools.name: meta_list_campaigns
tools.description: [Meta] List campaigns on an ad account (id, name, status, effective_status, objective, budget, dates). NOTE: daily_budget/lifetime_budget are in the currency's MINOR unit (cents/pence — ÷100). The core tool for finding dead/clutter campaigns.
tools.behavior: Meta Marketing API: lists campaigns with status, budget, objective and timestamps.

tools.name: meta_update_campaign
tools.description: [Meta][WRITE] Change a campaign's status — ACTIVE / PAUSED / ARCHIVED / DELETED. The tidy verb for dead campaigns (prefer ARCHIVED over DELETED — reversible).
tools.behavior: Meta Marketing API: posts a campaign status change.

tools.name: meta_list_custom_audiences
tools.description: [Meta] List custom audiences on an ad account (id, name, size, subtype, status, dates).
tools.behavior: Meta Marketing API: lists custom audiences including subtype, size bounds and operation status.

tools.name: meta_delete_custom_audience
tools.description: [Meta][WRITE] Delete a custom audience (destructive — removed, not archived).
tools.behavior: Meta Marketing API: deletes a custom audience.

tools.name: meta_list_pixels
tools.description: [Meta] List ad pixels / datasets on an ad account (id, name, last_fired_time) — spot stale/duplicate pixels.
tools.behavior: Meta Marketing API: lists ad pixels with last fired time and availability.

tools.name: ga4_account_summaries
tools.description: GA4 Admin: list the accounts + properties you can access, including each property's NUMERIC id — use this to discover GA4_PROPERTY_ID.
tools.behavior: Google Analytics 4 Admin: lists accessible account summaries and property IDs.

tools.name: ga4_list_key_events
tools.description: GA4 Admin: list key events (conversions) on a property.
tools.behavior: Google Analytics 4 Admin: lists property key events.

tools.name: ga4_create_key_event
tools.description: GA4 Admin [WRITE]: mark an event name as a Key event (conversion). e.g. eventName='generate_lead'.

propertyId.description: Numeric GA4 property id (the property id, distinct from the G- measurement id). Defaults to GA4_PROPERTY_ID.

tools.behavior: Google Analytics 4 Admin: creates a key event with eventName and countingMethod.

tools.name: ga4_list_custom_dimensions
tools.description: GA4 Admin: list custom dimensions on a property.

propertyId.description: Numeric GA4 property id (the property id, distinct from the G- measurement id). Defaults to GA4_PROPERTY_ID.

tools.behavior: Google Analytics 4 Admin: lists property custom dimensions.

tools.name: ga4_create_custom_dimension
tools.description: GA4 Admin [WRITE]: register an event parameter as a custom dimension (e.g. surface a 'step' param as 'Booking Step').

propertyId.description: Numeric GA4 property id (the property id, distinct from the G- measurement id). Defaults to GA4_PROPERTY_ID.

tools.behavior: Google Analytics 4 Admin: creates a custom dimension with parameterName, displayName and scope.

tools.name: ga4_list_data_streams
tools.description: GA4 Admin: list data streams (web/app) on a property — incl. the measurement id.

propertyId.description: Numeric GA4 property id (the property id, distinct from the G- measurement id). Defaults to GA4_PROPERTY_ID.

tools.behavior: Google Analytics 4 Admin: lists property data streams.

tools.name: ga4_admin
tools.description: GA4 Admin API escape hatch — any method/path under analyticsadmin v1beta (audiences, property/stream updates, etc.). WRITES are real; PATCH usually needs a updateMask query.
tools.behavior: Google Analytics 4 Admin: forwards arbitrary v1beta method/path, optional query string and body.

tools.name: gsc_submit_sitemap
tools.description: GSC [WRITE]: submit / resubmit a sitemap.

siteUrl.description: Search Console property: URL-prefix form with its trailing slash, or sc-domain:<domain>. Defaults to GSC_SITE_URL.

tools.behavior: Google Search Console: submits a sitemap with PUT.

tools.name: gsc_delete_sitemap
tools.description: GSC [WRITE]: remove a sitemap (re-submittable).

siteUrl.description: Search Console property: URL-prefix form with its trailing slash, or sc-domain:<domain>. Defaults to GSC_SITE_URL.

tools.behavior: Google Search Console: deletes a sitemap with DELETE.

tools.name: gsc_add_site
tools.description: GSC [WRITE]: add a property to Search Console (ownership still has to be verified separately).
tools.behavior: Google Search Console: adds a property with PUT; does not verify ownership.

tools.name: gsc_request_indexing
tools.description: Indexing API [WRITE]: ask Google to (re)crawl a URL. NOTE: officially for JobPosting/BroadcastEvent pages; pinging general URLs works but is unofficial.

type.description: Default URL_UPDATED; URL_DELETED reports the page as removed.

tools.behavior: Google Indexing API: posts a URL_UPDATED or URL_DELETED notification; unrelated to GTM.

tools.name: gtm
tools.description: Google Tag Manager API v2 escape hatch — any method/path under tagmanager/v2. Discover: GET 'accounts', then '<acct>/containers', then '<container>/workspaces'. Manage: GET/POST '<workspace>/tags' | '/triggers' | '/variables'; create a version (POST '<workspace>:create_version'); publish (POST '<containerVersion>:publish'). WRITES + PUBLISH are real and affect the live site — build in a workspace, publish deliberately.
tools.behavior: Forwards GET, POST, PUT or DELETE to Google Tag Manager API v2 with the supplied relative path, raw JSON body and optional query string using OAuth.

tools.name: kw_volume
tools.description: Keyword → monthly search volume / CPC / competition, batched (DataForSEO, Google Ads data). Send hundreds at once — deduped and chunked 500 per API call (≈ $0.05–0.075 per 1k keywords). Includes the 12-month monthly_searches trend.

location.description: DataForSEO location code. Default 2840 (US); 2826 is the UK.

tools.behavior: DataForSEO: deduplicates and batches keywords in groups of 500 for Google Ads search volume and returns volume, CPC, competition and monthly trends.

tools.name: kw_serp
tools.description: Live top-10 Google organic results for one keyword (DataForSEO) — position, domain, title, url — plus ads:true when paid results share the SERP (the commercial-intent signal). A fraction of a cent per query.

location.description: DataForSEO location code. Default 2840 (US); 2826 is the UK.

tools.behavior: DataForSEO: requests live Google SERP depth 20 and returns the first 10 organic results plus paid-result presence.

tools.name: kw_suggest
tools.description: Mine Google autocomplete for a topic — FREE, no credentials. Expands the seed a–z, recurses on new finds, and returns the deduped sorted list: the visible query surface of a topic, i.e. what people actually type. depth 2 takes ~a minute; depth 3 can take several.

gl.description: Country for suggestions (ISO alpha-2). Default us.

tools.behavior: Google autocomplete: mines the seed and alphabet expansions, recursively probes fresh suggestions up to clamped depth 3 and returns sorted unique results.

tools.name: kw_radar
tools.description: The demand-radar sweep. Reads the cluster file ~/.oqva-marketing-mcp/radar/<slug>.json ({clusters:{group:[terms]}, watchlist:[terms], locations:[codes]}), sweeps volume + top-10 SERP + suggest presence for every term × location, snapshots to radar/<slug>/<date>.json, and returns ONLY what changed since the previous snapshot: watchlist crossings (first suggest appearance / first nonzero volume — the headline), suggest appearances/disappearances on tracked terms, volume shifts >20%, and SERP top-10 entrants/dropouts/movers of ≥3 positions. First ever run returns {baseline:true}. Run weekly.

location.description: Sweep one DataForSEO location code only. Default: every code in the file's locations.

tools.behavior: DataForSEO and Google autocomplete: reads a local keyword cluster file, sweeps volume/SERP/suggestions, writes a dated snapshot and returns changes since the previous snapshot.

review.summary: Send GTM API requests with a chosen HTTP method, relative path, optional query, and raw JSON request body.
